prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn bounded_range_gaps(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed decimal integers in -1000..1000. Duplicate values are allowed. Return, in increasing order, every integer strictly between the minimum and maximum that is absent from the input, joined by commas. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: 3,1,3,6 returns 2,4,5.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: fn nums(s:&str)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut o=vec![];for z in s.split(','){let x:i32=z.parse().ok()?;if x.to_string()!=z||x< -1000||x>1000{return None}o.push(x)}Some(o)}fn join(a:&[i32])->String{a.iter().map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")}pub fn bounded_range_gaps(s:&str)->Option<String>{let a=nums(s)?;let s:std::collections::HashSet<_>=a.iter().copied().collect();Some((*a.iter().min()?+1..*a.iter().max()?).filter(|x|!s.contains(x)).map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","))}
